name: 🔔 Notification System
description: Sistema notifiche configurabile per Heca. V1 implementa notifiche in-app tramite i widget esistenti `Toast`, `ToastStack`, `ToastSpec` e `ToastSeverity`; Heca possiede modello, store, queue, lifecycle, timer, dedup, routing e dispatch azioni. Backend OS/system notifications e integrazione global KeyHint per azioni toast restano differiti. Out of scope: confirmation modals e confirmation-before-action flow.
workDone: Notification domain model, store, lifecycle, dispatch, ToastStack mount, the name-keyed notify action, the public Notification::send() builder + single raise door, a first real producer (pane creation, with a Focus action), and the [settings.notification_system] auto_dismiss_ms config knob. All code-complete and green.
workRemaining: Antonio's drive-through of everything raised so far. The toast's mouse interaction (×, action buttons, hover) is blocked on P097 (One Tree — the input architecture), a new phase: the app has no pointer-input pass for ordinary layers. Then the per-severity lifetime decision (T503), the closure action form, config-reload producers (P062), tests/README (P057), the remaining P055 producers, and the deferred OS backend (P063).
